strengths: The prayer grounds gratitude in toddler-scale gifts and avoids abstract praise language.
It makes the baseline distinction clearly enough: gifts are received before they are earned, and praise becomes obedient love.
Catholic mode is modest but real through grace, Trinitarian petition, and praise with the whole Church.
concerns: Catholic devotional texture is still light; it does not draw much from liturgy or sacramental imagination beyond Church and grace language.
grader_note: Approved on independent regrade. Its simple morning gratitude is not generic self-help; it moves from received grace to concrete toddler obedience and Church-shaped praise.
